```{r}
data <- read.csv("gss.csv")
```

```{r}
df <- data[data$year >= 1980 & data$year <= 2024, ]
```

```{r}
happy_health <- c('year','happy','natheal')
df_hh <- df[,happy_health]
```

```{r}
df_hh <- df_hh[complete.cases(df_hh), ]
```

# Visualize

```{r}
df_hh2 <- df_hh %>%
  filter(happy %in% 1:3, natheal %in% 1:3) %>%
  mutate(
    year = as.integer(year),
    happy_f = factor(happy,
                     levels = c(1,2,3),
                     labels = c("Very happy","Pretty happy","Not too happy")),
    too_little = as.integer(natheal == 1)
  )

tl_by_year <- df_hh2 %>%
  group_by(year) %>%
  summarise(p_tl = mean(too_little, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")
```

```{r}
p <- ggplot() +
  geom_bar(data = df_hh2,
           aes(x = year, fill = happy_f),
           position = "fill", stat = "count", width = 0.9, alpha = 0.95) +

  geom_line(data = tl_by_year,
            aes(x = year, y = p_tl,
                color    = "NATHEAL: Too little",
                linetype = "NATHEAL: Too little"),
            linewidth = 1.1) +
  geom_point(data = tl_by_year,
             aes(x = year, y = p_tl,
                 color = "NATHEAL: Too little",
                 shape = "NATHEAL: Too little"),
             size = 1.8) +

  scale_fill_manual(
    name = "Happiness (share per year)",
    values = c("Very happy" = "#1f77b4",
               "Pretty happy" = "#ff7f0e",
               "Not too happy" = "#2ca02c")
  ) +

  scale_color_manual(
    name = NULL,
    values = c("NATHEAL: Too little" = "black")
  ) +
  scale_linetype_manual(
    name = NULL,
    values = c("NATHEAL: Too little" = "solid")
  ) +
  scale_shape_manual(
    name = NULL,
    values = c("NATHEAL: Too little" = 16)
  ) +

  labs(x = "Year",
       y = "Share (within year)",
       title = "Happiness Distribution and Support for More Government Health Spending",
  subtitle = "Bars: happiness (Very/Pretty/Not too happy) within each year\n\
Line: share responding the government spends 'too little' on health (NATHEAL)") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 10) +
  guides(
    fill     = guide_legend(order = 1,
                            ncol = 1,
                            keyheight = unit(6, "pt"),
                            keywidth  = unit(10, "pt"),
                            override.aes = list(size = 3)),
    color    = guide_legend(order = 2, override.aes = list(linewidth = 1.1, size = 1.5)),
    linetype = guide_legend(order = 2),
    shape    = guide_legend(order = 2)
  ) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "right",
    legend.title = element_text(size = 9),
    legend.text  = element_text(size = 8, lineheight = 0.9),
    legend.key.height = unit(6, "pt"),
    legend.key.width  = unit(10, "pt"),
    legend.margin = margin(0,0,0,0),
    legend.box.margin = margin(0,0,0,0),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )

p <- p +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = pretty(df_hh2$year, n = 15),
                     minor_breaks = pretty(df_hh2$year, n = 30)) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format(),
                     breaks = pretty(c(0,1), n = 10),
                     minor_breaks = pretty(c(0,1), n = 20))

p
```

```{r}
df_hh2 <- df_hh %>%
  filter(happy %in% 1:3, natheal %in% 1:3) %>%
  mutate(
    year       = as.integer(year),
    happy_f    = factor(happy, levels = c(1,2,3),
                        labels = c("Very happy","Pretty happy","Not too happy")),
    too_little = as.integer(natheal == 1)
  )

tl_by_year <- df_hh2 %>%
  group_by(year) %>%
  summarise(p_tl = mean(too_little), .groups = "drop")

p <- ggplot() +
  geom_bar(data = df_hh2,
           aes(x = year, fill = happy_f),
           position = "fill", stat = "count") +

  geom_vline(xintercept = 2020, linetype = "dashed",
             linewidth = 0.4, alpha = 0.6) +

  geom_line(data = tl_by_year,
            aes(x = year, y = p_tl, color = "NATHEAL: Too little"),
            linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(data = tl_by_year,
             aes(x = year, y = p_tl, color = "NATHEAL: Too little"),
             shape = 16, size = 1.1) +

  scale_fill_manual(
    name = "Happiness (share per year)",
    values = c("Very happy" = "#1f77b4",
               "Pretty happy" = "#ff7f0e",
               "Not too happy" = "#2ca02c")
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(
    name = NULL,
    values = c("NATHEAL: Too little" = "black")
  ) +

  labs(
    x = "Year",
    y = "Share (within year)",
    title    = "Happiness Composition and Perceived Underfunding of Health",
    subtitle = "Bars: HAPPY distribution (within year).\nLine: share answering NATHEAL = 'too little'."
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = scales::breaks_pretty(n = 12)) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0,1),
                     labels = percent_format(accuracy = 1),
                     breaks = seq(0, 1, 0.1),
                     expand = expansion(mult = c(0.01, 0.02))) +

  theme_minimal(base_size = 9) +
  guides(
    fill  = guide_legend(order = 1, nrow = 1, byrow = TRUE,
                         keyheight = unit(5, "pt"), keywidth = unit(10, "pt"),
                         override.aes = list(size = 3)),
    color = guide_legend(order = 2,
                         override.aes = list(linetype = "solid", shape = 16,
                                             linewidth = 1, size = 1.1))
  ) +
  theme(
    legend.position   = "bottom",
    legend.spacing.x  = unit(3, "pt"),
    legend.title      = element_text(size = 8),
    legend.text       = element_text(size = 8, lineheight = 0.9),

    plot.title        = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold"),
    plot.subtitle     = element_text(size = 9),

    axis.title        = element_text(size = 9),
    axis.text         = element_text(size = 8),

    panel.grid.minor  = element_blank()
  ) +
  coord_cartesian(clip = "off")

p
```

# Test

```{r}
hh <- df_hh %>%
  filter(happy %in% 1:3, natheal %in% 1:3) %>%
  mutate(
    year       = as.integer(year),
    very_happy = as.integer(happy   == 1),   # 1 = Very happy
    too_little = as.integer(natheal == 1),   # 1 = Gov spends "too little" on health
    POST20     = as.integer(year >= 2020)
  )

p_vh  <- mean(hh$very_happy)
p_tl  <- mean(hh$too_little)

p_vh_pre  <- mean(hh$very_happy[hh$POST20==0])
p_vh_post <- mean(hh$very_happy[hh$POST20==1])
p_tl_pre  <- mean(hh$too_little [hh$POST20==0])
p_tl_post <- mean(hh$too_little [hh$POST20==1])

test_vh <- prop.test(
  x = c(sum(hh$very_happy[hh$POST20==0]), sum(hh$very_happy[hh$POST20==1])),
  n = c(sum(hh$POST20==0),                sum(hh$POST20==1))
)
test_tl <- prop.test(
  x = c(sum(hh$too_little[hh$POST20==0]), sum(hh$too_little[hh$POST20==1])),
  n = c(sum(hh$POST20==0),                sum(hh$POST20==1))
)

list(
  overall = c(p_vh = p_vh, p_tl = p_tl),
  pre_post = c(p_vh_pre = p_vh_pre, p_vh_post = p_vh_post,
               p_tl_pre = p_tl_pre, p_tl_post = p_tl_post),
  test_vh_p = test_vh$p.value,
  test_tl_p = test_tl$p.value
)
```

```{r}
mod_main <- glm(too_little ~ very_happy + factor(year), data = hh, family = binomial())

main_row <- tidy(mod_main, conf.int = TRUE, exponentiate = TRUE) |>
  dplyr::filter(term == "very_happy")
main_row
```

```{r}
mod_inter <- glm(too_little ~ very_happy * POST20 + factor(year), data = hh, family = binomial())
out_inter <- tidy(mod_inter, conf.int = TRUE, exponentiate = TRUE) |>
  dplyr::filter(term %in% c("very_happy","very_happy:POST20"))
out_inter
```

```{r}
OR_pre  <- out_inter$estimate[out_inter$term == "very_happy"]
OR_int  <- out_inter$estimate[out_inter$term == "very_happy:POST20"]
OR_post <- OR_pre * OR_int
c(OR_pre = OR_pre, OR_post = OR_post)
```

# Statistical Test

```{r}
hh_q3 <- df_hh %>%
  filter(happy %in% 1:3, natheal %in% 1:3) %>%
  mutate(
    year       = as.integer(year),
    vh  = as.integer(happy == 1),  # Very happy
    ph  = as.integer(happy == 2),  # Pretty happy
    nth = as.integer(happy == 3),  # Not too happy
    tl  = as.integer(natheal == 1) # NATHEAL = Too little
  )

yr3 <- hh_q3 %>%
  group_by(year) %>%
  summarise(
    p_vh = mean(vh),
    p_ph = mean(ph),
    p_nth = mean(nth),
    p_tl = mean(tl),
    n = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```

```{r}
cor_vh  <- cor.test(yr3$p_tl, yr3$p_vh)
cor_ph  <- cor.test(yr3$p_tl, yr3$p_ph)
cor_nth <- cor.test(yr3$p_tl, yr3$p_nth)

cors_tbl <- tibble(
  happy_band = c("Very happy","Pretty happy","Not too happy"),
  r          = c(unname(cor_vh$estimate), unname(cor_ph$estimate), unname(cor_nth$estimate)),
  ci_low     = c(cor_vh$conf.int[1], cor_ph$conf.int[1], cor_nth$conf.int[1]),
  ci_high    = c(cor_vh$conf.int[2], cor_ph$conf.int[2], cor_nth$conf.int[2]),
  p_value    = c(cor_vh$p.value, cor_ph$p.value, cor_nth$p.value)
)
cors_tbl 
```

```{r}
yr <- df_hh %>%
  filter(happy %in% 1:3, natheal %in% 1:3) %>%
  mutate(
    year = as.integer(year),
    vh   = as.integer(happy == 1),  # Very happy
    ph   = as.integer(happy == 2),  # Pretty happy
    nth  = as.integer(happy == 3),  # Not too happy
    tl   = as.integer(natheal == 1) # Too little
  ) %>%
  group_by(year) %>%
  summarise(
    p_vh  = mean(vh),
    p_ph  = mean(ph),
    p_nth = mean(nth),
    p_tl  = mean(tl),
    n     = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

m_y_w <- lm(p_tl ~ p_vh + p_nth + year, data = yr, weights = n)

hac_vcov <- NeweyWest(m_y_w, prewhite = FALSE)
hac_tab  <- coeftest(m_y_w, vcov = hac_vcov)

out <- broom::tidy(hac_tab) |>
  dplyr::rename(term = 1, estimate = 2, std.error = 3, statistic = 4, p.value = 5)
out
```
